citation.authors: Schorr ES, Sidou F, Kerrouche N, et al

record.population: Adults with healthy skin (number not given in the abstract)
record.design: Randomised, investigator-blinded, split-face study: tretinoin 0.05% cream to the whole face once daily, plus an SPF 30 ceramide moisturiser (a marketed product) once daily to one randomised side
record.finding: About 83% to 86% of people had irritation on both sides, mostly mild on the moisturiser side. Tolerability preferences favoured the moisturiser plus tretinoin side, and the authors concluded the moisturiser improved tolerance of tretinoin.
record.note: Marketed product, probably industry-run; funding not checked. It tested adding a moisturiser, not the order of application; ancestry not given.
